{{Quote|As the racers head out past the forest, they'll make their way up around the Tower of Eyes, and then down around this Clutter Junkyard.|[[Dax Gazaway]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Racer Revenge">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''</ref>}}
The '''Clutter Junkyard''' was a junkyard on [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. It was located on the [[Watchtower Run/Legends|Watchtower Run]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] track.

*''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''
